question: What is the range and damage of a Young White Dragon's Cold Breath?
expected_answer: 30-foot Cone, 35 (7d10) Cold damage, DC 15 Constitution saving throw, half damage on success

bm25_free_haiku.answer: 30-foot Cone, DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw, 40 (7d10) Cold damage on failure, half on success. Recharge 5-6. Source: SRD_CC_v5.2.1.pdf, page 340.

quality.notes: All mechanical details correct: 30-foot cone, DC 15 Con save, 7d10 Cold, half on success. Minor discrepancy on displayed average (40 vs expected 35) but dice notation matches. Bonus: included Recharge info.
